content: अभिषवः [अभि-सु-अप्] .²1 Extracting or pressing out the Soma juice. चक्रुस्ते विधिवद्राजंस्तथैवाभिषवं द्विजाः <ls>Mb. 14. 88. 21</ls>. .²2 Distillation or extraction (of liquors <ab>&c.</ab>). .²3 Religious bathing, ablution preparatory to religious rites. .²4 Bathing or ablution (in general); जपोपवासाभिषवैर्मुनीनाम् <ls>Ki. 3. 28</ls>. .²5 Drinking the Soma juice. .²6 A sacrifice in general. .²7 Ferment, yeast; any substance producing fermentation. .²8 A finger used in extracting Soma juice (<ls>Nir.</ls>). .²9 Coronation; रामाभिषवसंयुक्ताश्चक्रुरेव कथा मिथः <ls>Rām. 2. 6. 16</ls>. .{@-वम्@} Sour gruel.
